description: A CRM deal board in the Svelte 5 data grid. A KPI strip shows pipeline value, weighted value, win rate, average deal size and cycle time, recomputed from the visible rows; stage funnel chips scope the grid to one stage with live counts; owner, stage, probability and next step are editable inline; clicking a row opens a detail aside with contact, activity feed, health signals and Advance, Mark won and Mark lost actions; and a forecast bar rolls per-stage weighted contribution against the quarter's quota.

faq.question: How do the KPIs follow the filters?
faq.answer: They are $derived over the filtered deals array that the grid renders, so a stage chip or a column filter changes the totals in the same pass.

faq.question: What happens when the stage is edited inline?
faq.answer: onCellValueChange bumps the probability to the stage's default when the stage changes, and the KPIs, chips and forecast bar update from the row.

faq.question: How is the row detail opened?
faq.answer: onActiveCellChange resolves the row and sets it as the selected deal; the aside renders from that object, and its buttons mutate the same row.
